items.description: This is a set of tutorials for learning NLP. The repository claims to have a complete package for anyone looking forward to learn NLP.

items.title: Neural Networks: Zero To Hero
items.description: This youtube playlist has a lot of materials related to neural networks. This guy is going from the basic concepts like back propagation, to building your own GPT model from scratch. There are lots of things going on in this playlist and they seem kind of unrelated to each other.

items.title: Online Labs and Playground
items.description:
They have several online in-browser labs to mess around with ranging from linux terminals tp C++ labs. It's in a virtual and isolated environment so you don't have to worry about breaking anything. Good for those who are just starting to learn about stuff without the hassle of setting up an environment dedicated to the technologies they want to use.

They also have skill trees, which can assist you in figuring out what to learn next in your career path.

Adding icing on top, they have several project guidelines and tutorials as well which can get you some hand-on.

items.title: OpenStax
items.description: They provide free educational resources for a variety of subjects.

items.title: Operating Systems: Three Easy Pieces
items.description:
First of all it a FREE online book. Although I haven't read it in detail but I have crawled through the topics it discusses.
I remember that learning about OS was very boring, especially when there was no code involved. After all, we don't understand unless there is some tangible mechanics to understand. Not only this book has got your back on tangible examples, but also contains comprehension questions, homework(which includes code) and projects.
